import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyOpenCover

/-! Singular cochain maps for a two-set open cover.

This packages the restriction and overlap-difference maps on ordinary singular
cochains.  The later comparison proof can use these maps as the target short
complex for `exact_of_simplicialCohomology_iso`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X : TopCat}

/-- The degreewise product of the singular cochain complexes of two subspaces. -/
def integralSingularCochainPairComplex (U V : Set X) :
    CochainComplex (ModuleCat ℤ) ℕ :=
  CochainComplex.of
    (fun n => ModuleCat.of ℤ
      (IntegralSingularCochain (TopCat.of U) n × IntegralSingularCochain (TopCat.of V) n))
    (fun n => ModuleCat.ofHom
      ((singularCochainDifferential (TopCat.of U) n).prodMap
        (singularCochainDifferential (TopCat.of V) n)))
    (by
      intro n
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro φ
      exact Prod.ext (singularCochainCoboundary_squared φ.1)
        (singularCochainCoboundary_squared φ.2))

/-- Simultaneous restriction from the union to the two members of a cover. -/
def integralSingularCochainUnionRestriction (U V : Set X) :
    integralSingularCochainComplex (TopCat.of (U ∪ V : Set X)) ⟶
      integralSingularCochainPairComplex U V :=
  CochainComplex.ofHom
    (fun n => ModuleCat.ofHom
      (LinearMap.prod
        (singularCochainPullback (singularSubsetMap X Set.subset_union_left) n)
        (singularCochainPullback (singularSubsetMap X Set.subset_union_right) n)))
    (by
      intro n
      simp only [integralSingularCochainComplex, integralSingularCochainPairComplex,
        CochainComplex.of_d]
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro φ
      apply Prod.ext
      · simpa [integralSingularCochainComplex, integralSingularCochainPairComplex,
          CochainComplex.of_d, singularCochainDifferential]
          using (singularCochainPullback_coboundary
            (singularSubsetMap X Set.subset_union_left) n φ).symm
      · simpa [integralSingularCochainComplex, integralSingularCochainPairComplex,
          CochainComplex.of_d, singularCochainDifferential]
          using (singularCochainPullback_coboundary
            (singularSubsetMap X Set.subset_union_right) n φ).symm)

/-- Difference of restrictions to the overlap. -/
def integralSingularCochainIntersectionDifference (U V : Set X) :
    integralSingularCochainPairComplex U V ⟶
      integralSingularCochainComplex (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) :=
  CochainComplex.ofHom
    (fun n => ModuleCat.ofHom
      ((singularCochainPullback (singularSubsetMap X Set.inter_subset_left) n).comp
          (LinearMap.fst ℤ _ _)
        - (singularCochainPullback (singularSubsetMap X Set.inter_subset_right) n).comp
          (LinearMap.snd ℤ _ _)))
    (by
      intro n
      simp only [integralSingularCochainComplex, integralSingularCochainPairComplex,
        CochainComplex.of_d]
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro φ
      change singularCochainCoboundary
            (singularCochainPullback _ n φ.1) -
          singularCochainCoboundary (singularCochainPullback _ n φ.2) =
        singularCochainPullback _ (n + 1)
            (singularCochainCoboundary φ.1) -
          singularCochainPullback _ (n + 1)
            (singularCochainCoboundary φ.2)
      rw [← singularCochainPullback_coboundary,
        ← singularCochainPullback_coboundary])

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem integralSingularCochainUnionRestriction_intersectionDifference (U V : Set X) :
    integralSingularCochainUnionRestriction U V ≫
        integralSingularCochainIntersectionDifference U V = 0 := by
  apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext
  funext n
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro φ
  simp only [integralSingularCochainUnionRestriction,
    integralSingularCochainIntersectionDifference, integralSingularCochainComplex,
    integralSingularCochainPairComplex]
  change singularCochainPullback (singularSubsetMap X Set.inter_subset_left) n
      (singularCochainPullback (singularSubsetMap X Set.subset_union_left) n φ) -
    singularCochainPullback (singularSubsetMap X Set.inter_subset_right) n
      (singularCochainPullback (singularSubsetMap X Set.subset_union_right) n φ) = 0
  rw [← singularCochainPullback_comp, ← singularCochainPullback_comp]
  exact sub_self _

end Mumford.Analytic
